independentReasoning: For n=1,...,28, the discriminant is (7n)^2-4(10)(n^2)=9n^2, so the roots are (7n±3n)/20=n/2 and n/5. At least one integer root exists exactly when n is divisible by 2 or 5. There are 14 multiples of 2 and 5 multiples of 5, with 2 multiples of 10 counted twice, hence 14+5-2=17 favorable values out of 28. Thus the probability is 17/28, choice 4.
